scope: Olszówka / Gardeja local hydrology research network

evidence_policy.confirmed: Named or described by an official/public source.
evidence_policy.field_report: User-observed condition that requires independent remote-sensing or hydrological verification.
evidence_policy.candidate: Feature visible in public mapping or inferred as a possible connection; do not treat as a confirmed hydrological link until official geometry/data verifies it.

questions: When did persistent surface water begin to decline?
Is the loss seasonal or permanent?
Is the basin connected to a ditch, culvert, groundwater or another surface-water body?
Has shoreline or surface-water extent changed measurably?
Where are the verified inflow and outflow connections?
Are water-colour changes correlated with vegetation, sediment or hydrological conditions?

candidate_flow_chain.rule: Do not extend this chain upstream to Staw w lesie, Jezioro Kamień, Jezioro Nogat, Wandówka or Cyganówka without geometry/elevation evidence.

investigation_plan: Load official Hydroportal/Geoportal hydrography and water-management geometry for the local AOI.
Build a directed graph of lakes, rivers, ditches, channels, culverts and control structures using verified flow direction/elevation.
Measure annual and seasonal surface-water extent from EC JRC Global Surface Water 1984-2024.
Build Sentinel-1 water masks and Sentinel-2 shoreline/NDWI/MNDWI time series with product IDs and timestamps.
Compare lake changes with precipitation, evapotranspiration, soil moisture and available official groundwater observations.
Flag outlets, culverts, road crossings, abrupt channel-width changes and dense vegetation as inspection candidates, never as confirmed blockages from imagery alone.
Add official bathing-water and laboratory measurements when available; do not infer water quality solely from image colour.
